user_prompt: Please select the single project from this shortlist of 20 that best matches Fatima Sarah Khalid values and scoring criteria. State your winner clearly and explain your reasoning in 3-4 sentences.
raw_response:
**Winner: Decidim**

Decidim stands out as the clear winner because it embodies nearly all of my core values. It is a genuinely open source, community-governed civic commons platform deployed by hundreds of governments worldwide, demonstrating its public infrastructure value. Its cooperative governance model (Decidim Free Software Association) ensures it remains community-driven rather than vendor-controlled, while its focus on citizen participation aligns perfectly with structural inclusion and democratic empowerment. The project also has strong potential for AI governance contributions through its participatory framework, making it a rare example of technology that serves both immediate civic needs and long-term democratic resilience.
